summary: Implemented all six plan phases: a byte-identical marker-delimited helper now resolves a linked git worktree to its parent checkout at the registration hook, the verifier (plus new check (f)), and all three [repo:<slug>] provenance sites (read, write, and the scoping probe). Added six regression cases and a lockstep guard, recorded the two-channel asymmetry in per-repo-scoping.md, and verified all four acceptance criteria live against the real checkout and the live vault, including a direct GET /v1/search cross-check proving a second repository's tagged object is excluded under scoping.

artifacts.summary: Full implementation summary covering all six phases, live acceptance evidence, the Batch Gate Deferral scoped discharge of Phase 6's full-gate-set step, and follow-ups.
